## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Fridge Price prediction)—Predicts refrigerator retail prices from brand, capacity, energy rating, and feature attributes.

## Problem & Data

Appliance shoppers compare many SKUs; a model helps normalize price vs. specifications.

## Approach

Retail data scraping, categorical encoding, regression training, and residual analysis.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Fair-price estimates highlighting over/under-priced listings.
